text:
Priya S: quick thread  I'm landing a refresh PR for the Greeter quickstart that touches auth, first-deploy, and CI snippets (PR #4988). Want a fast sanity check, esp for Gitpod and GitHub Actions examples.
Alex P: happy to. I can run the Gitpod flow this afternoon. Which files changed?
Priya S: README, docker-compose.yml, .env.example, and the .github/workflows/minimal-deploy.yml. Main goals: pick a single env var name, add a Gitpod hint, make the compose port overridable, and shrink the GH Actions snippet to an illustrative minimal job.
Sam T: +1 on single env var. Recommend REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere. Also add a one-line note about least-privilege scopes for tokens.
Nina R: for Gitpod please show how to add the secret in the UI and a quick note about forwarding ports (Gitpod auto-forwards but you still want the exposed port). Maybe a tiny devcontainer/Gitpod comparison sentence.
Alex P: ran the Gitpod workspace: missing ports mapping in devcontainer.json made the preview not open. Suggest adding "forwardPorts": [${GREETER_PORT:-3000}] example and mention `GITPOD_OPEN_PORT`.
Priya S: good. For docker-compose I propose `ports:\n  - "${GREETER_PORT:-3000}:3000"` and include GREETER_PORT in .env.example.
Sam T: also swap any `API_KEY` occurrences in samples/ to REDWOOD_API_KEY. I can grep and send a tiny PR to normalize.
Priya S: thanks. For GH Actions I want a 4-line job that shows: set REDWOOD_API_KEY secret, checkout, run `redwood start --prod`. No full workflow. Keeps copy-paste easy.
Nina R: tiny UX nit: don't recommend `setx` on Windows. Show PowerShell session var: `$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY = "<key>"; npm run start` and a Bash equivalent.
docs-bot: PR #4988 updated by priya  labels: docs, quickstart, gitpod
Alex P: pushing a micro-commit to add the Gitpod note and devcontainer forwardPorts line.
Sam T: pushed normalization branch that replaces API_KEY -> REDWOOD_API_KEY across samples.
ci-bot: smoke tests for priya/greeter-qsr-refresh  status: queued
Priya S: plan: merge Sam's normalization first, then land the Gitpod + compose + GH Actions edits, then @Nina for copyedit. Target: EOD tomorrow. Thanks team :sparkles:
